plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 BSN Program Plan of Study (cuchicago.edu, College of Health Science & Technology). Eight-semester plan as published. Semester 2: the listed courses sum to 19 SH but the official header states 16-17 (official discrepancy, recorded as-is). Gen-ed flex rows transcribed at the low end of the printed ranges. Plan sums to 123 SH as transcribed. Prerequisite nursing courses (marked *) require a grade of C or higher; three prerequisite nursing courses must be completed before fall of sophomore year.
